wire.text: ANC, down to 30.76% nationally (3,246 of 10,526 seats, from 45.59% in 2021), nears coalition deal with ActionSA, EFF and MK sidelining the DA (35% in Johannesburg vs ANC 20%); parties have until 27 Nov to form local governments.
Boat carrying mourners to a funeral capsized Friday after mechanical failure; at least 4 killed, including 2 adults and 2 children.
Iraqi forces deploy to Jurf al-Sakhar, south of Baghdad, to assert state control in a longtime Kataib Hezbollah stronghold.
Australia jobless rate rises to 4.9% in October, highest in five years.
Anthropic falls 8.5% in its second trading session after its $107.3bn IPO (priced $83, opened $111.50 on 19 Nov, now ~$97) as the tech selloff continues.
